about: Feather palm: fronds on a stick: tapered trunk + crownshaft cylinder + n arched fronds (sweeps), 6-14 by visibility (Fam_Plants board, 15 Oct 2026). 2 species as types, size first (height in mm, then the species). Coarse: a box at the type's true overall size, locked to the labelled planes (Height, Crown Diameter, Crown Height, Trunk Height, Trunk Diameter), so it flexes for any type. Medium and Fine: each species' own primitives at its size, switched by Species Index (Show <Species> = Species Index = k on every solid's and plan line's Visible); a revolution's profile can't be locked to planes yet, so a type a person adds shows the Coarse box at its size but the species shapes of the type it was copied from until its own are drawn. Fine adds the secondary parts. Plan: symbolic lines per species (the board's symbol, crown outline at the mature spread) at every detail level; 3D solids are off in plan. Flower dots (Fine) and Growth / Variation are not built: they wait for an array op and kit parameters. FMC_Planting_Size and FMC_Plant_Spacing_mm are left for the landscape designer.
